meta_description: Cold-chain assurance on IoT evidence — spoilage claims down 57% and pharma contracts won on data the customer can audit

blocks.x: Cold-chain assurance on IoT evidence, spoilage claims down 57% and pharma contracts won on data the customer can audit
Identity withheld, a cold-chain provider whose temperature excursions were discovered at delivery and argued about for weeks after. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.

The baseline quarter unpacked the disputes: 3.9% of pharma shipments with temperature excursions, claims settled on partial evidence, and two pharma contracts lost to competitors who could prove the cold chain end to end.
Loggers existed but read out at the end; the reefer's story was reconstructed after the damage. Nobody could intervene in transit because nobody saw in transit.

We made the chain observable: real-time temperature and door telemetry per shipment with lane-level alerting, excursion predictions surfacing before thresholds breach, intervention playbooks dispatched to drivers with the evidence in hand, and the customer portal exposing the full chain, every reading, every action, under the pharma customers' own audit. Compliance became a feature we sell.
